1.web: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
1.asv: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; Make known among the peoples his doings.

2.web: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
2.asv: Sing unto him, sing praises unto him; Talk ye of all his marvellous works.

3.web: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
3.asv: Glory ye in his holy name: Let the heart of them rejoice that seek Jehovah.

4.web: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
4.asv: Seek ye Jehovah and his strength; Seek his face evermore.

5.web: Remember his marvelous works that he has done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
5.asv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

6.web: you seed of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
6.asv: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, Ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

7.web: He is Yahweh, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
7.asv: He is Jehovah our God: His judgments are in all the earth.

8.web: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
8.asv: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, The word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

9.web: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,
9.asv: The covenantwhich he made with Abraham, And his oath unto Isaac,

10.web: and confirmed the same to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
10.asv: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant,

11.web: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance”;
11.asv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance;

12.web: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
12.asv: When they were but a few men in number, Yea, very few, and sojourners in it.

13.web: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
13.asv: And they went about from nation to nation, From one kingdom to another people.

14.web: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
14.asv: He suffered no man to do them wrong; Yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

15.web: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
15.asv: Saying, Touch not mine anointed ones, And do my prophets no harm.

16.web: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.
16.asv: And he called for a famine upon the land; He brake the whole staff of bread.

17.web: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.
17.asv: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a servant:

18.web: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
18.asv: His feet they hurt with fetters: He was laid inchains ofiron,

19.web: until the time that his word happened, and Yahweh’s word proved him true.
19.asv: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of Jehovah tried him.

20.web: The king sent and freed him; even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
20.asv: The king sent and loosed him; Even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

21.web: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions;
21.asv: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his substance;

22.web: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
22.asv: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.

23.web: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
23.asv: Israel also came into Egypt; And Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

24.web: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
24.asv: And he increased his people greatly, And made them stronger than their adversaries.

25.web: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
25.asv: He turned their heart to hate his people, To deal subtly with his servants.

26.web: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
26.asv: He sent Moses his servant, AndAaron whom he had chosen.

27.web: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
27.asv: They set among them his signs, And wonders in the land of Ham.

28.web: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.
28.asv: He sent darkness, and made it dark; And they rebelled not against his words.

29.web: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
29.asv: He turned their waters into blood, And slew their fish.

30.web: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
30.asv: Their land swarmed with frogs In the chambers of their kings.

31.web: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.
31.asv: He spake, and there came swarms of flies, And lice in all their borders.

32.web: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
32.asv: He gave them hail for rain, Andflaming fire in their land.

33.web: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
33.asv: He smote their vines also and their fig-trees, And brake the trees of their borders.

34.web: He spoke, and the locusts came, and the grasshoppers, without number,
34.asv: He spake, and the locust came, And the grasshopper, and that without number,

35.web: ate up every plant in their land; and ate up the fruit of their ground.
35.asv: And did eat up every herb in their land, And did eat up the fruit of their ground.

36.web: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.
36.asv: He smote also all the first-born in their land, The chief of all their strength.

37.web: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
37.asv: And he brought them forth with silver and gold; And there was not one feeble person among his tribes.

38.web: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
38.asv: Egypt was glad when they departed; For the fear of them had fallen upon them.

39.web: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.
39.asv: He spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to give light in the night.

40.web: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
40.asv: They asked, and he brought quails, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

41.web: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
41.asv: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out; They ran in the dry places like a river.

42.web: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
42.asv: For he remembered his holy word, AndAbraham his servant.

43.web: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
43.asv: And he brought forth his people with joy, Andhis chosen with singing.

44.web: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
44.asv: And he gave them the lands of the nations; And they took the labor of the peoples in possession:

45.web: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!
45.asv: That they might keep his statutes, And observe his laws. Praise ye Jehovah.
